title: top-up: record-only branch detection for issue-run change detection
definition: Review that changesOnlyRunRecords is true only for a non-empty path list whose every entry is exactly this issue's PR summary path or the top-level .pr_response_message, and that readBranchChangedPaths unions the base...HEAD diff, tracked uncommitted changes and untracked non-ignored files, splitting NUL-separated output, and returns an error naming the git command, never an empty list, when any git call fails.
